candidate_source: M6 frozen candidate_scores.csv, development-only proxy universe
normalization: min-max fitted on eligible development candidate universe only
promotion: development promotion candidate only; external HF remains unauthorized

roles.RANKING-CHAMPION-STRESS: performance with rank ambiguity and pairwise reversals
roles.RESIDUAL-TAIL: tail and systematic LF/model correction risk

scope: zero-solver targeted development HF acquisition design only

score_construction.coverage_control: 0.55 nearest-HF16 distance + 0.25 LF response distance + 0.20 geometry diversity
score_construction.polarization_stress: 0.70 P/S proxy + 0.20 predicted P/S disagreement + 0.10 residual risk
score_construction.ranking_ambiguity: 0.50 rank variance + 0.30 performance potential + 0.20 near-champion margin
score_construction.residual_tail: 0.35 tail + 0.25 M7 model disagreement + 0.20 Ridge-CNN disagreement + 0.20 order-risk

tie_break: descending role score, then descending geometry_hash lexicographic
